acceptance_oracle: For every claimed durable worker operation terminal transition, emit one newline-delimited JSON record after durable state persistence with an event timestamp, operation id/kind, fixed worker label, elapsed duration, truthful terminal result, safe error code when present, and applicable internal entity id. Exception messages and operation parameters, including resume rewrites and secret-like content, never appear.
gap_observation: Durable worker tasks persisted terminal results and sanitized errors but emitted no operation-level structured log. Default RQ text formatting would wrap a JSON message unless the operation logger has a dedicated JSON-only handler.
implementation: Added dedicated workers.mjobs.operations logger configured to emit JSON-only lines to stdout from worker startup, separate from RQ text loggers.
Terminal operation events are emitted after the durable state/audit transaction succeeds. Stale ownership returns emit no terminal event.

Fixed fields allowlist operation kinds/results, identifier shape, worker label and safe uppercase error codes. Only operation-specific identifiers are included; arbitrary params, exception messages, profile data and resume text are not serialized.
Captured unit and connected worker lifecycle tests verify success/failure records, valid JSON output, and omission of synthetic secret/private rewrite content.
